root_cause: We repeatedly scaled count-based proof runners because completed proofs were not converted into authoritative map entries.
Scale was used as a proxy for maturity, but scale only proves throughput/mechanics unless there is real use/exam/active-state proof.
Validators prove their own route contracts, not global Builder memory or live intelligence unless designed for that.
Existing maps/markers are not auto-updated; the conductor loses body memory and rebuilds similar runners.
recommended_next: Do not build another candidate-count runner.
Create MAP_PATCH_CANDIDATE_V1 for existing maps with diagnosed capabilities and explicit NOT_PROVEN gaps, without runtime_ready promotion.
After map patch review, run exactly one real delta/use diagnostic: fixed exam prompts, before answers, retrieve/use atoms, after answers, independent validator.
Only after that decide whether MAP_AUTO_UPDATE deserves organ construction.
do_not_do: Do not commit/push current dirty tree before isolating scope.
Do not call 30K proof real learning.
Do not run another 5K/30K scale proof as the next step.
Do not treat quarantined Codex draft as accepted implementation.
